title: Attaining liberation by giving up ego

flashcards.back: Renunciation is giving up work done for personal profit; sacrifice is freedom from attachment to the fruits of all work.
No one can give up work completely, so a Tyagi is one who gives up attachment to its fruits.
The body, the doer (the modes), the organs, the life forces, and fate. The Self alone is not the doer.

flashcards.front: Knowledge in the mode of goodness
flashcards.back: Sees one Reality in all beings, undivided in the divided.
Goodness: steady, free of ego. Passion: craving, greedy, swayed by joy and grief. Ignorance: careless, stubborn, lazy.

flashcards.front: Intellect in the mode of goodness
flashcards.back: Knows right from wrong, bondage from liberation; passion confuses them; ignorance takes wrong for right.
Sense pleasure is nectar at first and poison in the end. The pleasure of goodness is bitter at first, sweet at the end.

flashcards.front: On what is the division of labour based?
flashcards.back: On one's natural qualities and ability, not on birth.
One reaches perfection by worshipping God, from whom all beings come, through one's natural work.
Purified intellect, firm resolve, sense control, no likes and dislikes, solitude, light eating, meditation, detachment, no ego.
God abides in all hearts and makes beings work out their Karma, which their own past choices created.
Set aside doership, ownership and attachment; surrender to God's will. He frees you from all Karma: do not grieve.
Offer all actions to God, make him your goal, depend on him, keep your mind on him, and practise Karma-yoga.
Where Krishna, Lord of yoga, and Arjuna, with the weapons of duty, are together, there are prosperity, victory and morality.
Neither alone frees: wisdom and devoted duty together lead to liberation.

quiz.text: What does true renunciation give up?

options.C: Attachment to the fruits of work

quiz.text: How many causes of action does Krishna name?
quiz.why: Body, doer, organs, life forces, fate.

quiz.text: Knowledge in the mode of goodness sees:
Which intellect takes wrong for right?
quiz.why: Passion confuses them; ignorance inverts them.

quiz.text: Pleasure that is nectar at first and poison at the end is in the mode of:
The division of labour is based on:

options.A: Freedom from all sin and Karma

quiz.why: Surrender to his will; do not grieve.

quiz.text: Which pair, per 18.78, brings victory and prosperity?

options.D: Krishna and Arjuna: wisdom and duty
